name: catalog-publication-cross-surface-readback
objective: إغلاق Central Catalog + Business Vertical policy + server publication gate وإثبات نفس store/product truth عبر Field/Control Panel/Partner/Client دون shadow data.
truthOwner: Central Catalog owns product/category identity; DSH store domain owns assortment/local price-stock and publication readiness.

tasks.objective: Prove and converge central catalog/publication truth for one field-originated store across all required readers.
tasks.currentProblem: Business vertical/local category drift and incomplete publication gating can create shadow or prematurely public truth despite a central catalog implementation.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind vertical policy to central domains, remove competing local identity/state, enforce server publication prerequisites, and update all related Catalogs/Partners tabs/readers.
tasks.targetState: Field selects central products, store-local commercial attributes remain store-scoped, publication happens only when all prerequisites pass, Partner and Client see the same IDs and public data.
tasks.action: Trace catalogs/store APIs/db/controllers, inventory Control Panel Catalogs/Partners tabs, test invalid/unpublished/disabled/stock/price/override cases, and remove proven obsolete local catalog remnants.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Vertical policy وcatalog domains متسقة.
كل Catalogs/Partners tabs المرتبطة تعرض canonical state.
tasks.rollback: Preserve canonical IDs/data and forward-fix publication policy; do not restore local catalog truth.
